name: io.github.exileum/meta
description: Enables AI assistants to manage Instagram and Threads accounts — publish content, handle comments, view insights, search hashtags, and manage DMs through the Meta Graph API

environmentVariables.name: INSTAGRAM_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Instagram Business/Creator account ID (numeric string, or "me" for the authenticated user)

environmentVariables.name: THREADS_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Threads user ID (numeric string, or "me" for the authenticated user)

environmentVariables.name: META_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Meta App ID for token/webhook tools (numeric string)

environmentVariables.name: META_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Meta App Secret for token/webhook tools

environmentVariables.name: META_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Optional Meta Graph API version for Instagram and Facebook endpoints (defaults to v25.0; format vMAJOR.MINOR; OAuth token endpoints are unversioned)

environmentVariables.name: THREADS_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Optional Threads API version (defaults to v1.0; separate single-major-version track from the Graph API)
